recognize_zh: 箭頭標出的兩個細胞是深染、邊緣平直、兩端呈方形的長方形棒狀結晶，第三個（雙箭頭）是摺疊成船形的緻密紅血球；周圍有多個標靶細胞。這種平行邊緣的六角／長方形結晶是血紅素 C 結晶（HbC crystals）的典型外觀。
features: Two dense, dark-staining rectangular crystals with parallel straight sides and blunt ends (single arrows)
A dense, folded boat-shaped cell (double arrow)
Crystal-containing cells appear devoid of surrounding pale hemoglobin
Several target cells and a few crenated/echinocytic cells in the background
No sickle cells present in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear at high power shows target cells with occasional crenated red cells. Two red cells are replaced by dense, dark-staining rectangular crystals with straight parallel edges and blunt ends (arrows), and a third shows a dense folded, boat-shaped configuration (double arrow). Sickle cells are not identified. Findings are consistent with hemoglobin C crystals, characteristic of hemoglobin C disease; hemoglobin HPLC/electrophoresis is recommended for confirmation.

ddx.vs: HbSC crystals are more irregular and angulated, often with finger-like projections or multiple knobs, and coexist with occasional sickle forms.
Sickle cells are crescentic with tapered pointed ends rather than straight-sided, blunt-ended rectangles.
Elliptocytes remain pale-centered ovals and do not show the homogeneous dense staining and sharp parallel edges of HbC crystals.
